headword: {風炉先屏風|ふろさきびょうぶ}

definitions.explanation: A low, usually two-panel {屏風|びょうぶ} placed behind the {風炉|ふろ} (portable brazier) and tea utensils in the tea ceremony, marking off the host's working space.

examples.japanese: {風炉先屏風|ふろさきびょうぶ}を{置|お}く。
{茶席|ちゃせき}に{風炉先屏風|ふろさきびょうぶ}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: A tea screen was set up at the tea gathering.

examples.japanese: {風炉先屏風|ふろさきびょうぶ}は{道具|どうぐ}の{背景|はいけい}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}める{役割|やくわり}がある。
examples.english: The tea screen serves to visually frame the utensils.

notes:
A specialized tea-ceremony ({茶道|さどう}) screen, lower than an ordinary {屏風|びょうぶ}, set behind the {風炉|ふろ} and utensils to define the host's space.

RELATED WORDS:
- {屏風|びょうぶ}: folding screen
- {風炉|ふろ}: portable brazier used in the tea ceremony
- {茶道|さどう}: the way of tea
